en.question: A content-moderation guardrail uses Claude to classify outputs as safe or unsafe before delivery. What is the most important operational consideration?

options.text: It should reuse the generation call's model and prompt for consistency.
options.note: An independent check is worth more; sharing prompt and model correlates failures.

options.text: It should run after delivery so the user never waits on the extra call.
options.note: Checking after delivery defeats the purpose entirely.

options.text: It is probabilistic too, so it needs its own evals, error rates, and failure policy.
It supersedes the other safety layers, which can then be retired safely.
options.note: It is one layer in defence in depth, not a replacement for the rest.

en.explanation: A model-based filter is a probabilistic component like any other. It needs labelled evaluation, ongoing measurement of both error directions, and an explicit fail-open or fail-closed policy.
